title: Bots are going to get a lot worse and completely ruin the economy

posts.cooked: With AI-driven pixel bots and visual machine learning models, botting is about to explode. Traditional anti-cheat checks won't be able to catch bots that interact like human players, visually reading the screen and moving in human-like curves. This will completely flood the economy and destroy any value for normal gathering professions. We are entering a botpocalypse.
